outcome: serum level of high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP)
ratio of immature to total neutrophils
cohort: Fifty preterm infants with early onset neonatal sepsis (EONS) were selected from the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) of Qaem Hospital, Mashhad, Iran.
finding: rhG-CSF administration significantly improved White Blood Cells (WBC) count and Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC) in preterm infants with early onset neonatal sepsis, but showed no significant changes in mortality rate, adverse effects, or hospital stay.
followup_time: 3 days (for biochemical parameters), duration of hospitalization (for clinical parameters)
